description.purpose: Complete Maya Iqbal's LLC-related deposit-account migration, selecting suitable replacement products, preserving opening eligibility, funding the agreed destinations, and closing the two retired accounts.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Maya Iqbal, a 46-year-old small-business bookkeeper in Boise, Idaho. Your sole-owner bookkeeping LLC registration has just been confirmed. You are cooperative and practical, but want the whole banking move completed correctly.

Begin: "My bookkeeping LLC registration just came through, and I'd like to reorganize my bank accounts before I start using it. I thought clearing out the old accounts first would make sense. Can you help?"

Only when asked relevant identity questions, provide the requested details: Maya Iqbal; date of birth 06/22/1979; address 2846 W Aldercrest Lane, Boise, Idaho 83703; email maya.iqbal@example.net; phone +1-208-555-0146. Answer verification questions and permit successful verification to be recorded for this call only after you have answered them.

When asked about the move or affected accounts, explain that you want both replacement accounts opened and both old accounts closed in this call if eligible: replace Bronze savings, establish business checking, and retire Evergreen checking. Keep Light Blue open and untouched for everyday use. Your clean-up-first idea is tentative, not a condition of the move.

When asked about balances or allocation, explain: move all $420 from Bronze to the replacement savings; from Evergreen's $4,780, put $3,180 into replacement savings and $1,600 into business checking. Light Blue holds $240 and must not fund the move. Do not change these allocations or add other products.

When asked about account history or notice, say both closure notices were acknowledged on November 6. Evergreen was opened March 12, Bronze July 9, and Light Blue November 1, all this year.

When asked about business-account needs, say you saw Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, and Sky Blue and want the cheapest regular option. Require an ongoing $0 monthly maintenance fee, no minimum balance, no reliance on a balance waiver, and no expiring free period. When asked about savings needs, say you can keep about $3,600, want daily compounding, and may need up to 15 withdrawals a month without an excess-withdrawal charge. Relationship or ATM benefits would be nice but are not conditions; you do not know their eligibility rules. Do not name a preferred replacement as a predetermined answer.

If the agent proposes opening accounts first without explaining why, briefly ask why the old ones cannot be cleared out first. After a clear practical explanation that still allows the whole move, acknowledge that you had not realized order mattered and ask them to proceed with the agreed move. Before authorizing any account or balance changes, require the agent to identify the proposed products and affected accounts, confirm your allocation, and explain a departure from your tentative closures-first order. You may then authorize the complete plan; approving its order does not approve changes to your requirements.

If a proposal or reported result conflicts with these requirements, withhold consent and briefly point out only the affected personal requirement. For example: "That doesn't match the move I asked for. Can you check a plan that finishes the whole change while keeping my everyday account alone and the money going where we agreed?" Mention a quoted fee, balance condition, expiring offer, unsuitable savings feature, added product, or missing opening or closure only when it is the actual conflict. Do not copy an incompatible product or allocation merely because the agent recommends it. If a conflicting action has already happened, ask for it to be corrected and continue toward the same complete move rather than accepting completion. Do not diagnose hidden eligibility rules, supply policy calculations, or introduce another banking request.

Accept only after the agent confirms both new accounts and their agreed funded balances, closure of both Bronze and Evergreen, and Light Blue still open and unchanged, with no conflicting product, allocation, extra account, or charge. If anything is missing, ask about that missing outcome; do not stop after a partial result. Once all these visible conditions hold, thank the agent briefly and end with exactly one marker:
###STOP###
